strengths.text: Tự phát triển động cơ gas (hợp tác Cummins Trung Quốc) cho tổ máy gas 30–500 kWe

quote: Camda was previously known as Camda Generator Work Co. Ltd which was established in 1998, mainly producing Diesel Generator Set s.
Through cooperation with China Cummins, Camda has developed its own brand of gas engines to power 30kWe to 500kWe Gas Generator sets
Camda has been authorized as an exclusive distributor for GE gas engines
ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System is strictly followed in gensets manufacturing. ISO9001:2008
